scope: 23 native categories x four pools; 3 distinct admitted models per pool
methods: Use each category own examples/category-policies-v1.json native thresholds; never reuse global coding scores for other categories.
Exact catalog IDs/canonical_slug from category-index only. No fuzzy name, guessed effort/provider or version equivalence.
Collapse API aliases with the same explicit canonical_slug; never count provider endpoints as distinct models.

Exclude ambiguous source rows, multi-canonical matches and unsupported output modalities. A canonical model with source variants on different sides of thresholds is wholly excluded; no best-score selection.
OSS proposal inventory requires that same category score and a nonempty weights repository association; license, local runtime resources and independent OSS admission remain unverified.

Historical proposal counts describe unreviewed score-to-catalog inventory before qualification, provider, full-cost, price-spread and speed checks. Fresh counts additionally apply per-category source TTL using min(retrieved_at,as_of). They are not selected or usable backup configurations.
Replay existing research matrix through prepare_backup_pools at report time; verify the hash-bound plan and retain admitted counts. No F50 answer/outcome informs proposal choice.
Existing coding admissions apply solely to the fixed bounded SQL research workload. They do not qualify all coding jobs, other categories, production, or the new backup runtime forecast.

price_scenario.reason: Token-price scenario does not supply complete failure/retry/cache/reasoning/classifier costs or net savings.

missing_low_reason.reason: Applicable actual exact Q50 measured report required

source_row_reference_format: cached manifest request name:source_row_index; manifest and raw files SHA256 are recorded in sources

method: Keep existing research-admitted exact profiles first, solely within the recorded SQL workload. They are not production or new-backup-runtime qualifications.

For other slots use only same-category same-native-tier exact canonical identities from this report. Missing version/effort stay null; catalog canonical association never proves actual runtime revision.

A comparable historical quote is 2000 noncached input + 1000 output tokens using explicit nonnegative USD/token prompt and completion rates. Do not substitute omitted cache, reasoning, failure or classifier fees as zero complete cost.

Choose the least quote endpoint per exact model, break ties by available historical endpoint p50 milliseconds then request model ID/provider. Missing p50 sorts last. This is not whole-task latency or a full-cost qualification.

Choose least quote pending primary, then prefer provider diversity for pending backup slots and sort by the same quote/p50/stable-ID order. Family is not inferred. All OpenRouter routes share an entrance; different provider tags do not prove physical independence.
Retain :free request suffixes; never replace a selected free route with a paid canonical route. No quoted zero rate is a binding all-path fee guarantee.

Historical stale-source names may be displayed with pending_unqualified_stale_source; they do not fill currently qualified slots. No source-mapped model or comparable quote means an explicit missing slot and discovered-list reason.
